notes.title: Patch 2018/3/13
notes.content:
List of changes:
[list]
[*]advanced wheel mode is now default, arcade mode is secondary
[*]rotation fix when a car isn't moving
[*]invisible walls in empty area between cities are replaced by soft braking area at the distance from the road
[/list]
